Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanSweep Services LLC provides comprehensive janitorial and cleaning services for commercial clients, including office buildings, retail spaces, and industrial facilities. Our operations involve routine cleaning, floor maintenance, window washing, and specialized services such as carpet cleaning and sanitization. We prioritize employee training and conduct thorough background checks to ensure trustworthiness and safety while on client premises. Our team is equipped with eco-friendly cleaning products and follows strict waste disposal protocols to mitigate environmental impact. Additionally, our fleet of well-maintained vehicles is used to transport staff and equipment to job sites, ensuring timely and efficient service delivery. We are committed to upholding high standards of cleanliness and client satisfaction while managing the inherent risks associated with our operations.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Key Risk Considerations
Janitorial and cleaning services present several unique underwriting
risks that must be carefully evaluated:
• Employee Theft and Dishonesty: Due to unsupervised access to client premises and valu-
ables, employee dishonesty is a significant exposure. Underwriters should assess the presence
of background checks, supervision policies, and prior claims history.
• Commercial Auto Risks: Many janitorial businesses operate fleets of vehicles transport-
ing staff, equipment, and chemicals. Proper vehicle maintenance, driver qualification, and
commercial auto coverage are essential to mitigate liability and physical damage exposures.
• Pollution and Environmental Liability: Use and disposal of cleaning chemicals can lead
to pollution claims, including contamination of client property or the environment. Coverage
should be limited to incidents arising directly from cleaning agents used during operations.
